hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Removing and adding characters only at the ends allows preserving any single contiguous common substring.

hints.title: Operation Reduction
hints.text: If a common substring of length L is preserved, the total operations required is len(initial) + len(target) - 2 * L.

hints.title: Maximizing Substring
hints.text: Compute the longest common substring between initial and target using standard dynamic programming.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Classic longest common substring dynamic programming with 1D space optimization.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all substring pairs takes cubic O(m^2 * n) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory using rolling DP rows.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that the problem reduces directly to finding the Longest Common Substring.
